messages.content: Answer in under 180 words. Give VERDICT, COUNTEREXAMPLE, and SMALLEST SAFE DEPENDENCY only.

StepValueUse statically sees only stepName plus two literal-true shell flags. Runtime call validation is later, and schema-less fallback does not check named keys. Jenkins 2.568.1 throws for echo(message:'x', unknown:true), unstable(message:'x', unknown:true), and unstash(name:'x', unknown:true). Fogell currently promotes the primary key, ignores unknown, runs, and returns VNull. Would declaring those step names GenuineNull and lifting StepValueUse remain sound without first adding/duplicating named-call schema? Review the decision to stop and require one shared descriptor/validator first.
